text: The project features an integrated risk reduction model combining structural measures, hydrometeorological monitoring, and community capacity building. It expands from 2 pilot districts to 12, covering over 7 million people. The project includes a gender assessment and action plan, and it focuses on community-based disaster risk management. It also involves significant technical upgrades for the Pakistan Meteorological Department.

metadata.solution_name: Scaling-up of Glacial Lake Outburst Flood (GLOF) Risk Reduction in Northern Pakistan (GLOF-II)
